notes.title: Crown Trick comes out on October 16th!
notes.content:
[h2]Our new roguelike dungeon crawler game Crown Trick comes out on October 16th![/h2]
[previewyoutube=rmCmLzEqwSY;full][/previewyoutube]
Crown Trick is a turn-based roguelike in which you play as Elle. Armed with only your magical talking crown to guide you, you’ll develop your own combat style; choosing between active and passive abilities and utilising relics to aid you along the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30518600/a70f7614e282f31dfda73c80325ae57bee96756b.jpg[/img]

Mastering the elements will also be a key pillar to your survival, and upon vanquishing the high-level familiars found lurking in the labyrinth, you will be able to steal their skills and wield them as your own in your journey to escape the Nightmare Realm!

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Engaging strategic gameplay: Monsters and traps move only when the player moves; carefully thought out strategies are key to escaping the labyrinthine dungeon
[*] Fight how you want: Create and develop a unique combat style with dozens of active and passive skills and abilities, items, and relics help create different ways to cut through enemy encounters
[*] Learn from enemies: Gather elite ‘Familiar’ skills by overcoming enemies ready to unleash on others deeper in the dungeon
[*] Different dungeons every time: The procedurally generated maze ensures players have unique experiences every time they enter the Nightmare Realm
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30518600/d6eb00f17df4daf686d00b9cd3562f07436488e7.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000010/Crown_Trick/
[h2]Add it to your Steam wishlist to keep up with the latest news or follow the channels below…[/h2]
[url=https://twitter.com/CrownTrickGame] Follow Crown Trick on Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/FbaXFNm]Join Crown Trick Discord Server[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/crowntrickgame/]Follow Crown Trick on Instagram[/url]

notes.title: 版本更新v1.0.1820 01/02/2019
notes.content:
- 本次更新内容
Update Notes

1. 修复习得“流萤”或“星辉”技能后，季姜在空中使用闪避打断释魄或赤霄空中连招的次数未作限制的bug。
Fixed bug when "Sidestep" or "Starshine" is unlocked, "Shuffle" should not cancel Ji's air combo attacks without being limited by the maximun number of times she can evade in the air.

2. 优化跳跃操作手感，将短按跳跃键的最小跳跃上升时间从0.1秒提升到0.2秒。（长按跳跃键的最大上升时间和高度都未作改动）
Polished jumping control, increased the minmum jumping time from 0.1 second to 0.2 second.(Didn't change the maximun jumping time and height)

3. 优化季姜进入防御动作的动作节奏表现，并优化防御和完美防御判定精确度。
Polished both the animation presentation and accuracy of the "Precision Strike"(Perfect Guard).

notes.title: 版本更新v1.0.1819 12/26/2018
notes.content:
- 本次更新内容
1. 新增了手柄键位自定义功能。
2. 优化键盘键位自定义功能，加入对小键盘按键的支持。
3. 优化了键盘操作模式下，“魂识”技能的按键排布顺序。并对获得新魂识技能时的自动装备顺序也做了对应调整。
4. 在所有剧情对白画面右上角增加了“跳过”功能的UI提示。
5. 在第一章齐王宫，补充了“跳跃”操作技巧说明。并加入到Loading时随机出现的游戏提示中。
6. 在第三章永巷，新增了“蹲下与落下”的操作说明。
7. 赤宵“星辉”技能的霸体效果修改为：可免疫除抓取以外所有怪物技能的打断效果。
8. 赤宵“星辉”技能，新增了可使用闪避或防御打断赤宵攻击的效果（“奔雷”除外；“贯日”、“追云”起跳腾空阶段除外）。
9. 释魄“流萤”技能，新增了可使用闪避或防御打断释魄空中攻击的效果（“旋舞”除外；“重影”持续攻击阶段除外）。
10. 加快了释放“魂识”技能时季姜的动画节奏，缩短了不可操作状态持续时间。
11. 赤霄“贯日”技能的伤害值和破霸体值提升33%。
12. 从游戏内选择“主菜单”退回到标题界面时，新增需要做二次确认的弹出对话框，以尽量避免误操作。

notes.title: 版本更新v1.0.1803 12/21/2018
notes.content:
- 本次更新内容
1. 新增键盘键位自定义功能。
2. 新增部分剧情对白跳过功能。（默认按 “暂停键 / ESC” 跳过）
3. 优化主角倒地起身过程中可以防御和跳跃的操作体验。
4. 修复了永巷及黄泉关卡中部分卡关的严重BUG。
5. 修复部分极端情况下导致存档出错的 BUG。
6. 修复中文繁体语言中，"後羿" 为 "后羿" 的文字错误，以及其他已知文字错误。

- 正在开发内容
1. 手柄键位自定义功能。
